claim: If PDT prediction probabilities are affine under classical preparation mixing and agree with QM on all pure states, they agree with QM on every mixed state. Uniform pure-state error <= epsilon implies mixed-state error <= epsilon.
scope: finite-dimensional density operators; fixed outcome/effect and fixed resource window
higher_dimension_test: unit tests sample convex mixtures through dimension 100
novelty: No novelty claimed for convex-affine quantum probability mathematics; PDT use is as a same-input kill test.
surviving_requirement_for_deviation: A genuine same-input PDT deviation must alter pure-state predictions, mixture affinity/preparation equivalence, microscopic state/effect assignment, dynamics, or measurement law.
